Based on your recent wellness retreat in Bali and your preference for tranquil, health-focused destinations with natural beauty and spiritual practices, I recommend considering Rishikesh, India, or Sedona, Arizona, USA. Rishikesh is known as the "Yoga Capital of the World," offering a serene environment along the Ganges River with numerous ashrams and meditation centers. Sedona offers stunning red rock landscapes that are ideal for spiritual grounding, hiking, and wellness retreats, providing a peaceful escape focused on personal well-being.
